services.name: chaintracks-server
services.state: Bulk-header files under BULK_HEADERS_PATH; upstream headers are reproducible.
services.migration: No schema migration. Validate the retained header corpus before rollout.
services.backup: Snapshot BULK_HEADERS_PATH or repopulate it from a verified source CDN.

services.name: message-box-server
services.state: Knex database plus optional Firebase device registrations.
services.migration: Migrations complete before listen; back up and verify the target schema first.
services.backup: Use the selected database engine's consistent snapshot and restore procedure.

services.name: overlay-server
services.state: Knex transaction state and MongoDB lookup-service state.
services.migration: Overlay migrations complete before listen; preserve both stores as one release boundary.
services.backup: Take coordinated MySQL and MongoDB backups before schema or image changes.

services.name: uhrp-server-basic
services.state: Local files and metadata under the configured public storage directory.
services.migration: No schema migration; preserve file and metadata consistency.
services.backup: Snapshot the complete storage directory and verify hashes before restore.

services.name: uhrp-server-cloud-bucket
services.state: Cloud bucket objects and provider metadata.
services.migration: No local schema migration; validate provider configuration before listen.
services.backup: Use provider versioning/replication and verify object hashes and retention policy.

services.name: wab
services.state: Authentication, identity-link, share, deletion-intent, and faucet database tables.
services.migration: Migrations complete before listen; verify rollback compatibility before rollout.
services.backup: Take an encrypted database snapshot and test identity/share recovery without logging secrets.

services.name: wallet-infra
services.state: Wallet Storage database, monitor state, transactions, outputs, baskets, and certificates.
services.migration: Storage migration and availability checks complete before the server starts.
services.backup: Take and verify a consistent database backup before every schema or image change.
